item.name: Mage License Contacts are part of a character’s contact Network. Whether they are vague acquaintances, friends of friends, or family members, they all contribute to the level of the Network skill and any possible specializations. It is important to note that a Contact Amp (regardless of its cost) is a character (or a group) that stands out primarily because of its narrative usefulness. Contacts are noted because you want to be able to use them narratively; otherwise, they would simply be one of the many acquaintances that make up the Network. Also note that the bonus provided does not necessarily represent the full extent of a contact’s possible influence, nor does it necessarily reflect their relationship with the character. An NPC can be influential, reliable, and loyal to the character and still be only a Level 0 Amp, simply because they are rarely reachable (which might, incidentally, explain a failed Network Test—whereas a success could be explained by the fact that this time you managed to contact him). Conversely, even if your best friend is extremely reliable, loyal, and available, if he doesn’t know anyone, he won’t be able to grant you a high RR. These are things to keep in mind when choosing Contact Amps.
